findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed the front handwashing sink did not have soap. Inspectors discussed with the PIC and they stated that an order had been placed for new handwashing soap. PIC found another bottle at the facility and brought the soap to the hand sink during the inspection. Ensure that there is always hand soap available at every hand washing sink for the proper hand washing procedure.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures & records.
findings.comment: Observed the rice was not marked with the four hour window for time-as-control. The PIC wrote down the time the rice was cooked during the inspection. They were reminded of the importance of identifying the time rice must be discarded. Ensure that the proper time-as-control policies are always followed.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.19(B)(3) Time as a Public Health Control. (B) If time without temperature control is used as the public health control up to a maximum of 4 hours: (3) The FOOD shall be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the FOOD is removed from temperature control.

findings.title: Toilet facilities: properly constructed, supplied, & cleaned
findings.comment:
5-501.17: The restrooms were observed to not have a covered trash can. Ensure that each restroom is supplied with a covered trash can. 
5-501.17: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: At the start of the inspection the sanitizer bucket was recorded at 0ppm QUAT. The PIC changed out this solution during the inspeciton. The new bucket of santiizer was tested and recorded at 150ppm QUAT. Ensure the sanitizer bucket is tested regularly and has the solution changed at a frequency necessary to maintain its efficacy. 
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: There are ants observed along the floor board in the kitchen under the triple sink. PIC informed inspector that Sentinel will be servicing the facility starting this Thursday where they will treat for pests. A follow-up will be conducted on Friday, September 8, 2023  to observe that the eradication of the ants has taken place. 
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
4-903.11: The cutting boards were observed drying behind the faucet of the triple sink. These boards were removed form this location and placed in a location not prone to splashing or accidental hand touching which would directly result in the contamination of the food contact surface. Ensure food contact surfaces, such as cutting boards, are stored in a location not prone to contamination. 
4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.
